notes: Manufacturer spec table lists "Video Port: 1× 3G-SDI, 1× HDMI 1.4b, 1×USB-A" with resolution specs described as "Input/Loop out" for both HDMI and SDI, indicating each is a single bidirectional physical connector (input with loop-through output) rather than separate in/out jacks. USB-A is input-only (webcam/UVC source or USB storage/headset — treated here as the video/audio input use case; USB is also used for storage and PTZ-control-via-USB-to-serial per the manual, so real-world use is closer to bidirectional, but the datasheet lists it under "Video Port...Input"). No external antenna connectors — P3 uses an internal antenna design (4x 5G/4G cellular modules + Wi-Fi 5, explicitly non-external-antenna). SIM card slots and SD card slot are not physical signal/power connectors and are omitted. Ethernet grade set to eth-1g per "1 × 1000Mbps Ethernet Port". No rack mounting — this is a portable backpack/handheld unit (211×143×68mm, ~2000g main unit) so rackUnits omitted. Power: "DC 12V/3A" via external power adapter, modeled as dc-barrel (exact barrel size not specified by manufacturer). Confidence is high because the source is the manufacturer's own current product/spec page with a complete, detailed specification table.
